description: This file defines the BlogApiController class, which provides API endpoints for managing blog posts, tags, images, and post properties within the Goteo project. It includes methods for listing posts, retrieving tags, uploading and deleting images, setting default images, and updating post properties.

classes.name: BlogApiController
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for blog management in the Goteo platform.

methods.name: validatePost
methods.description: Validates a blog post by slug, checking user permissions and publication status.

methods.name: postsAction
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of blog posts, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: tagsAction
methods.description: Returns a list of all blog post tags for suggestions.

methods.name: uploadImagesAction
methods.description: Handles AJAX image uploads for blog posts, with permission checks.

methods.name: deleteImagesAction
methods.description: Deletes a specified image from a blog post.

methods.name: postDefaultImagesAction
methods.description: Sets a default image for a blog post from its galleries.

methods.name: postPropertyAction
methods.description: Updates a specific property of a blog post via PUT request.
